thread.title: Nasdaq loses grip on 7,000 for first time in 3 weeks as stock-market selling accelerates

author: morningstar.com
title: Nasdaq loses grip on 7,000 for first time in 3 weeks as stock-market selling accelerates
text:
The Nasdaq Composite Index on Thursday lost its purchase above the round-number level above 7,000 for the first time since early April, as selling pressure in the stock market gathered steam late morning. The Nasdaq [c: COMP] was down 1.4% at 6,998, most recently. The technology-laden gauge last closed below 7,000 on April 9. Losses in the highflying sector come even as earnings reports from the likes of Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN), Facebook Inc. (FB), and Apple Inc. (AAPL) have come out better than expected. Meanwhile, the Dow Jones Industrial Average , most recently, was down about 340 points, or 1.4%, while the S&P 500 index shed 1.4% at 2,599. Both the Dow and the S&P 500 have slipped below their 200-day moving averages, which are used by technical traders to help determine bullish and bearish momentum in an asset.
-Mark DeCambre; 1105ET
